He has no veto except in case of a tie
The Speaker will NOT preside when a resolution for his removal from office is under consideration of the Assembly
explanation:
Most keys (APPSC Group-1 2022): Both (B) and (C). Strictly: (A) is also 'not a power' – the Speaker has only a casting vote (Art. 189), voting in the first instance only on a resolution for his own removal (Art. 181).

q: The Indian Constitution has conferred the responsibility for its enforcement on: Ind A) B)
explanation: The Constitution's enforcement rests on the Supreme Court as its guardian and final interpreter; the President and Parliament are bound by it.

q: Choose the correct answer relating to the Supreme Court of India:
options: A Supreme Court Judge addresses his resignation to the Chief Justice of India
The Supreme Court does not have the power to review its own judgments
All Civil and Judicial authorities in India shall act in aid of the Supreme Court
The Supreme Court has the autonomy to make rules for the practice and procedure of court
key_text: All Civil and Judicial authorities in India shall act in aid of the Supreme Court
explanation: Art. 144: all authorities, civil and judicial, shall act in aid of the Supreme Court. A judge resigns to the President, the Court can review its judgments (Art. 137), and its rules need the President's approval (Art. 145).

q: Choose the correct answer relating to the Supreme 37. Re Court of India. A C) an
options: The Supreme Court can strike down any law
The Supreme Court has the autonomy to make rules for the practice and procedure of court
The Supreme Court can issue ordinances
The Supreme Court advises the President on all matters
key_text: The Supreme Court has the autonomy to make rules for the practice and procedure of court
explanation: The SC frames rules of practice and procedure (Art. 145, with the President's approval). It cannot strike down any law (only unconstitutional ones), cannot issue ordinances (President, Art. 123) and advises the President only on references (Art. 143).

explanation: Art. 137 empowers the SC to review its own judgments or orders; Art. 136 is special leave, 141 binding law, 135 Federal Court jurisdiction.

q: In relation to supreme Court of India, choose the wrong answer
options: A supreme Court Judge addresses his resignation to the president
The Supreme Court has the power to review its own Judgements
All Civil and Judicial Authorities shall act in aid of the supreme Court
The Supreme Court has the complete independence and autonomy to make rules for the practice and procedure of court
key_text: The Supreme Court has the complete independence and autonomy to make rules for the practice and procedure of court
explanation: Wrong: the SC makes rules of practice and procedure only with the President's approval (Art. 145), so it lacks 'complete' autonomy. Resignation to the President, review power (Art. 137) and Art. 144 are correct.
